record.one_liner: All-in-one marketing, CRM and agency platform (GoHighLevel / HighLevel) with a documented public API and an official MCP server.
record.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 and Private Integration Tokens (PIT). PIT is a bearer token, counted as api_key per the rubric. Legacy API key generation is being phased out per the official docs.
record.access_notes: Official docs list API access on Starter ($97/month), Unlimited ($297/month) and Founder ($497/month). No free or trial path to API credentials was seen on the fetched pages.
record.api_notes: Versioned REST-style API with bearer auth (v2 and v3 routes). Some higher-tier endpoints are restricted by plan, scope or eligibility. api_style is inferred from the v3 bearer-auth reference; the page does not use the word REST.
record.blocker_notes: Real API access needs a paid HighLevel subscription (Starter minimum). The official MCP server connects through OAuth to a sub-account, so it also needs a paid account.
